slug: 2026-01-01 Starlink Partners with Airtel & Vodacom From Rival to Ally

facts.fact: The article lists the Democratic Republic of the Congo among the 25 African countries where Starlink operates as of November 2025; it gives no COD-specific licence, seller or subscriber detail (published 2026-01, no other date).

note: Airtel direct-to-cell and backhaul and Vodacom resale are pan-African, not stated for COD; only the country list names COD.
